articles.headline: Ant International upgrades AI model as banks adopt specialized tools for liquidity risk
articles.summary: Ant International launched an upgraded AI model and said major global banks are signing up as financial institutions accelerate specialized AI adoption for liquidity risk management. For businesses, this signals continued enterprise demand for AI that can directly affect treasury operations, risk controls, and financial planning.

articles.headline: OpenAI rolls out ChatGPT for Teens with extra safety protections
articles.summary: OpenAI is introducing a teen-focused ChatGPT experience with additional safety protections. While consumer-facing, the move matters for employers and schools because it shows how AI platforms are tightening age-specific controls and safety features that can spill over into broader governance expectations.

articles.headline: Amazon Prime Air expands toward nearly 500 U.S. cities
articles.summary: Amazon’s Prime Air is expanding rapidly, with coverage reported in nearly 500 U.S. cities. For local businesses and e-commerce operators, faster drone delivery could raise competitive pressure on fulfillment speed and last-mile expectations.
